verdict.rationale: Together AI publishes an OpenAPI 3.1.0 document ("Together APIs", v2.0.0) at docs.together.ai/openapi.yaml. llms.txt lists it under "OpenAPI Specs", and the per-endpoint API reference is generated from it. The probe's 404s covered only .json/swagger paths, so they do not contradict the YAML spec. Missing for 10: hands-on probe confirmation that openapi.yaml itself is fetchable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
